The '''Ord Tessebok system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Irishi sector/Legends|Irishi sector]] within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Tessebok]].
